messages:
maria: quick follow-up from today's all-hands about pricing/credits 

oliver: can we clarify behavior when a streaming response runs out of credits mid-request? clients reported inconsistent UX.
tayla: we should avoid silent truncation. plan: emit a final structured error event with code `quota_exceeded` and close the stream cleanly. SDKs surface that to UIs.
sam: note: if the org has auto-topup enabled and a charge succeeds mid-stream, we resume transparently. if charge fails, emit `billing_required`.
billing-bot: current 429 payload: {"error":"quota_exceeded","retry_after":1200,"remaining_credits":0} (retry_after in seconds).
oliver: request: include an `available_at` ISO timestamp for UI display in addition to seconds.
tayla: agreed 

proposal: keep `retry_after` (seconds) for machines + `available_at` ISO for humans. add `quota_state` in SDK events.
maria: leadership Q: can leftover promo/dev credits be converted to trial Dedicated capacity without manual sales ops? customers asked during Q&A.
billing-bot: policy: promo/dev credits are non-transferable by default; conversions are manual and require approvals.
sam: product idea: gated self-serve conversion (limits + audit trail) could be piloted for selected accounts. needs billing/legal signoff.
oliver: for rollouts: if a canary route hits rate limits, do we auto-failover? my concern is unexpected behavioral changes.
tayla: default is no automatic cross-route failover. opt-in fallback to compatible variant is allowed via route config.
maria: action items: 1) docs PR for mid-stream quota/auto-topup behavior (@tayla). 2) product spec for guarded credit conversions (@sam). 3) SDK hooks for `onQuotaError`/`onQuotaWarning` (@oliver).
maria: thanks all 44d 

(we'll sync tomorrow 10am PT for owners)
